lines: Hey there. Hank. Nuts and Bolts Hardware. If it's broken, I've got the bit for it. If it's not broken, give it time.
Step right up and bob for apples! Hands behind your back, face in the barrel, and no biting the barrel. Kip tried.
Three goes. The apples get sneakier every go. I've got towels.
Evening. Just sitting on the porch, watching the lights. Best part of the day.

rotate: Rakes are out front. Lot of leaves this year. The town's going to need some help raking. Hint, hint.
Skaters keep using my loading dock as a ramp. I pretend to be grumpy about it. I put the rail there.
Gus was in for a hinge. Third one this month. I think he just likes the walk.
Funny thing: the ground shook a bit last night. Just a little. Like the town hiccuped. Shelves rattled, nothing broke.
